steps.detail: a backup of the client file is made first; the write goes through the client's own lock and conflict check

plan.summary: Give Claude Code a direct entry 'alpha' for alpha
plan.undo: toolportctl client direct rm srv-alpha --client claude-code
warnings: A direct entry bypasses the Toolport gateway: its tools are not covered by access sets, approvals or lazy discovery, and every client with a direct entry starts its own process of the server instead of sharing one.
Secrets stay in Toolport: the launcher reads them when the client starts the entry; they are never written to the client file.

result.undo: toolportctl client direct rm srv-alpha --client claude-code
